products.name: MELAcare
products.description: Wellness for your instruments – Fully automatic, safe, and efficient MELAcare is redefining the reprocessing of transmission instruments: cleaning, disinfection, and oil maintenance are performed fully automatically, in a validatable manner, and with exceptional care for the instruments. For reliable workflows, maximum patient safety and instruments that are quickly ready for use again between treatments.Validatable reprocessing process according to EN ISO 15883-1/2 starting at approx. 14 minutes (Incl. internal drying and pre-cooling ) Gentle cleaning and disinfection without chemicals to preserve the value of your instruments Precise oil and collet maintenance for reliable function and long service life Intuitive operation and documentation via a large touchscreen display with batch approval directly on the device at no extra charge Compact design with high flexibility thanks to a small footprint and 28 specially developed adapters for hollow-body instruments MELAcare significantly reduces routine tasks and saves valuable time week after week in daily practice. With the Blue and Green lids, you can prepare different instrument groups safely, conveniently, and according to your needs. [MELAcare will be available in the EU from 15 July 2026. Availability outside the EU depends on the respective registration process.]

products.name: MELAcare Lid Blue
products.description: Premium Care for Rotary Instruments: The MELAcare Blue Lid is the ideal solution for cleaning, disinfecting and lubricating handpieces, contra-angles, turbines and contra-angle heads. With up to 6 individually configurable adapters, you can tailor the lid perfectly to your instruments - ensuring safe reprocessing and long-term reliable performance. Cleaning, disinfection and oiling in as little as 17 minutes for up to 6 rotating instruments (incl. internal drying and pre-cooling) ULTRAflow Technology for powerful internal and external cleaning with compressed-air-accelerated deionized water - completely chemical-free Thermal disinfection at approx. 95 °C with an A0 value of 3,000 and a broad spectrum of activity Precise oil and chuck care with fully synthetic oil for preserving value and optimal function Individually configurable with up to 6 adapters for handpieces, contra-angles, turbines, and contra-angle headsThe MELAcare Lid Blue makes the reprocessing of rotating instruments convenient, safe, and efficient. For instruments that are quickly ready for use again—and a workflow that becomes a WOWflow.

products.name: MELAcare Lid Green
products.description: More flexibility for instruments that do not require oiling:The MELAcare Green lid was specially developed for reprocessing hollow instruments that do not require oil care. With up to 6 individually configurable adapters, you can reprocess ultrasonic scaler tips, prophylaxis handpieces and other compatible instruments safely, efficiently between treatments. Reprocessing in just 14 minutes, including cleaning, thermal disinfection, internal drying and pre-coolingULTRAflow technology for powerful internal and external cleaning with deionised water - completely chemical-freeThermal disinfection at approx. 95 °C with an A0 value of 3,000 and a broad activity spectrum Configurable with up to 6 adapters for ultrasonic scaler tips and prophylaxis handpieces Quickly ready for use again thanks to efficient and intelligent additional cooling The MELAcare Lid Green brings maximum flexibility to the reprocessing of hollow instruments that do not require oil. For reliable results, efficient processes and a workflow that becomes a WOWflow.

products.name: MELAcontrol Helix
products.description: The new MELAcontrol Helix – Reliable Routine Testing for Class B Autoclaves The MELAcontrol Helix is a professional solution for reliable routine monitoring of Class B autoclaves. The Helix test was developed in accordance with the strict requirements of the European standard DIN EN ISO 11140 and offers a validated and compliant method for testing steam penetration in hollow instruments—a crucial factor for effective sterilization. By simulating the most challenging load conditions within the sterilization process, the Helix delivers highly meaningful test results and ensures maximum process reliability. A clear color change from blue to pink after successful sterilization enables fast, unambiguous evaluation and supports reliable documentation.✅ Fully compliant with ISO 11140✅ Reliable verification of steam penetration✅ Clear visual result for quick decision-making✅ High process safety with minimal time investment✅ Economical and sustainable solution for routine control To ensure consistently high test quality, every reorder of indicator strips includes a new Helix test body. This guarantees long-term reliability in batch monitoring while minimizing administrative effort.

products.name: MELAcontrol Pro
products.description: The so-called HELIX is covered by the EN ISO 11140-6 European Standard. This is a test body for "Class B" steam sterilizers, which simulate the complicated requirements for sterilizing hollow instruments. This test body is required for batch monitoring of the processing of "critical B" instruments. MELAcontrol Pro with 40 indicator strips is a durable, usable test body for the power-user. The test strips can be re-ordered in a refill package with 250 indicator strips.

products.name: MELAdem 53 C
products.description: The MELAdem 53 C works in accordance with the tried and tested ion exchange procedure, generating high-quality demineralized water for the cleaning, disinfection and sterilization process. It has been conceived to satisfy a requirement for large-volumes of aqua dem e.g. for the supply of the Cliniclave, MELAtherm and one or more practice steam sterilizers. The scope of delivery consists of two high-value cartridges filled with regeneratable resin, one of which is connected to the steam sterilizer and/or the MELAtherm. Once the cartridge has been exhausted, it is dispatched for regeneration and the second cartridge is brought into operation. The low height of the water treatment unit MELAdem 53 C in comparison to the MELAdem 53 makes it especially suited to installation in tightly-fitting situations. The high capacity of up to 2,100 l enables the connection of one or more steam sterilizers in addition to the MELAtherm. Do you already own a MELAdem 53 C and need a regeneration? Then get your regeneration now for just €210 using our form.

products.name: MELAstore Tray Ophthalmology
products.description: Optimize the instrument reprocessing in your ophthalmological practice or clinic with the MELAstore Tray Ophthalmology. Specifically designed for the demanding requirements of ophthalmology, the MELAstore Tray ensures maximum efficiency and safety throughout the reprocessing of your cataract surgery sets.Flexible and secure: The MELAstore Tray consists of an upper and a lower basket, equipped with flexible, positionable silicone supports. These guarantee a secure hold for both rigid and articulated instruments.Effective cleaning: The lower basket features an injection rail and versatile connections to ensure reliable cleaning and disinfection of your complex hollow instruments (e.g., phaco, irrigation, and suction handpieces).Time-saving: Instruments are inserted directly into the silicone supports after the procedure, significantly speeding up preparation and reprocessing through a standardised process.Space-saving: Up to 6 or 8 MELAstore Trays Ophthalmology can be space-efficiently placed in the universal holder of the MELAtherm 10 or MELAtherm 20 and optimally adapted for cleaning and disinfection.Protection against recontamination: After cleaning and disinfection, the upper and lower baskets are combined into a set and packed in a MELAstore Box 200. The integrated filter protects the instrument set from recontamination during storage.The MELAstore Tray Ophthalmology is only compatible with the MELAtherm 10 base basket with injection rail and plastic central filter (Art.-Nr. ME80440) or the Cleanfinity Pro (Art.-Nr. ME84650) central filter of the MELAtherm 20.
